text: Delivered sync/async memory readers, confined JVM filesystem, strict JDK HTTP Range, Scala.js Fetch, direct and two-phase sharded OpenedArray reads, bounded coalescing/concurrency, primitive assembly, receipts, edge-chunk correctness, and equivalent JVM/Browser two-range HTTP traces. zarrJVM/test passes 62/62 and zarrJS/test 63/63 warning-clean.
